days.title: Arrival, Cellular Jail, Carbyns Cove Beach, Light & Sound Show
activities: Morning: Arrival at Sri Vijaya Puram and check-in at the hotel.
Afternoon: Visit the historic Cellular Jail, followed by a trip to Carbyn's Cove Beach.
Evening: Attend the Light and Sound Show at the Cellular Jail to learn about the history of the freedom struggle, followed by a night stay at the hotel.

days.title: Swaraj Dweep, Radhanagar Beach & Kaalapathar Beach
activities: Morning: Take a cruise trip to Swaraj Dweep, check in at the resort, and relax and visit the world-famous Radhanagar Beach, perfect for swimming and known for its Blue Flag rating, blue waters, and white sandy shores.
Afternoon: Enjoy a sunset visit to Kaalapathar Beach.

days.title: Cruise to Shaheed Dweep, Coral Bridge & Return
activities: Morning: Take a cruise trip to Shaheed Dweep and visit the Coral Bridge (comfortable footwear recommended).
Afternoon: Take a cruise trip back to Sri Vijaya Puram.
Evening: Night stay at the hotel.

days.title: Baratang Excursion & Limestone Caves
activities: Morning: Early morning vehicle trip to Baratang, followed by a fiber boat trip to the Limestone Caves.
Afternoon: After your lunch, take a return trip to the capital, arriving by 4 PM for some shopping.
Evening: Night stay at the hotel.

days.title: Departure
activities: Morning: Airport drop with beautiful memories.
